zara (partnerships): Qubit Systems wants a compact perf/W matrix run Wed 10:00 PT. Aim: compare our int8 quant path vs fp16 on their devboard. Partner will join. Keep artifact sharing to aggregated CSVs only (no symbol maps or hostnames). Prep doc: https://go/redwood/qubit-watt-matrix :mag:

tom (eng-runtime): Plan: three profiles: fp16, int8-fast, int8-safe. We'll run warm and cold cache. Will cap power to 120W for comparability.

jing (kernel-team): Kernel patch is tiny memcpy+sched tweak. We won’t export kallsyms. Propose artifacts: metrics_<run_id>.csv, power_<run_id>.csv, hotspots_<run_id>.tsv (anonymized ids).

qubit-systems: We can supply board wall-power at 250ms and SoC telemetry (freq,temp). Our parser expects headers: ts_ms,power_w,soc_freq_mhz,board_temp_c. Include run_id please.

alex (bench-ops): I'll reserve rack and attach meter. Bench-bot will tag run_id=qubit-2026-05-12-1 and upload to s3://redwood-partner-exchange/qubit/. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/qubit-sweep.

bench-bot: Prechecks OK. Short command we'll run:

./bench_runner --model=tiny-llm --seq=1024 --batch=8 --runs=3 \
  --profiles=fp16,int8-fast,int8-safe --limit-watts=120 \
  --export-agg=metrics_<run_id>.csv --export-power=power_<run_id>.csv \
  --agg-hotspots=8

zara (partnerships): Action items: tom update runbook with exact commands and sample CSV header; jing push telemetry contract PR; qubit confirm CSV headers and read-only S3 access; alex orchestrate run and upload. Reconvene after ~11:30 PT for a quick readout. :rocket:
